attempted_claim: Fix an integer t >= 2. Let K be a field of characteristic zero, X an n x n generic symmetric matrix, L a symmetric ladder in the sense of Conca (Definition 1.1) with support Y, R=K[Y] standard graded, and I_t(L) the ideal generated by all t-minors of X contained in L. Determine as an explicit closed-form function of t and the corner/shift data of L the exact Castelnuovo-Mumford regularity reg(R/I_t(L)) (hence reg(I_t(L))=reg(R/I_t(L))+1). Prove equality via the squarefree diagonal Groebner degeneration and G-biliaison induction, not merely an upper bound.
decisive_failure: No complete or partial auditable result is claimed. The evidentiary basis is Gorla arXiv:0809.4337 read in full (Definitions 1.1/1.3, Lemma 1.6, Propositions 1.7/1.8, Theorem 2.4, Corollary 2.5) plus scope notes on Conca diagonal Groebner bases, Rajchgot-Robichaux-Weigandt 2022 (one-sided ordinary ladders only), and Pechenik-St.Denis 2025 (Pfaffian upper bound only). No computation was possible (no computer algebra installed) and the second literature call was deliberately unspent. The mixed-size regularity theory needed to unblock the target remains entirely open.
